Smith deactivated about 26 leased Flock cameras effective September 1, 2026 after Florida DOT ordered license plate readers off state highways within 30 days and Gov. Ron DeSantis urged removal. text: Robinson City Council voted unanimously September 1, 2026 not to renew the city's Flock Safety contract after a one-year trial. Coverage put 11 cameras in the city. The 2023 contract covers 15 Flock cameras and 54 Flock gunshot detectors. Cameras have been offline since August 19. Council planned a September 8 vote on a take-down date and how to avoid a possible about $35,000 early-termination fee. Faraldi said the latest the technology would be removed is May.
